body.name: \(\mathfrak I_{\mathrm{PT}}\)
body.def: The completed result \(\texttt{pid_slate_benefit_partialtransport}\) proves that the exact selected-complier partial-transport capacities are \(\Pi_+w_n\) and that the sharp benefit set is the closed interval \(\Theta_{I,n}=[N_{L,n}/M_n,N_{U,n}/M_n]\), with both endpoints attained by compatible latent couplings.
body.role: imported exact-capacity and closed sharp-endpoint mapping
